title.zh: 相似之下的确定：构型被命名时，确定就是相似之下的确定；关于构型如何相关的定理在相似之下成立，对相似者之一的干预、未登记的过去与未登记的描述需要相等
title.en: Determinacy up to likeness: with configurations named, determinacy is determinacy up to likeness; the theorems on how configurations relate hold up to likeness, while an intervention on one of alike configurations, an unregistered past and an unregistered description need equality

claim.zh: 确定恰是声称命名构型时的相似之下的确定（determined_iff_named、alike_configurations），所以每个用 Determined 陈述的定理都是一个用 DeterminedAt 陈述者的命名实例。以下在相似之下成立：经相似同去就是相似之下的确定（goesAlike_iff，对应 goAlike_id_iff）；相似的运行保持相似（DeterminedAt.stays_alike，对应 GoAlike.runs_agree）；一步不依赖的在相似之下被重新吸收（DependsOnlyOnAlike.reabsorbed）；遗忘噪声后，标准模型恰在噪声在相似之下无差别时在相似之下确定（forget_inputs_determinedAt_iff）；所取的动作在相似之下固定（Run.fixesAlike_of_takes），一次代表其类（Run.generalizesAlike）；在与所命名者相似的构型处从未取的动作，对在一个声称上不同的结果不被固定（Run.not_fixesAlike_of_untaken），经对整个相似类的干预（retargetAlike、retargetAlike_determinedAt）。以下需要相等，或登记相等所分开者的声称：对两个相似构型之一的重定向破坏相似之下的确定（Twins.retarget_breaks）；保留的历史在其现在回返且没有什么登记过去之处在相似之下回返（keepFrame_alike_iff、keepHistory_returns_alike），所以 keepHistory_new 需要过去被登记（keepHistory_new_named）；没有声称时每个描述承载规律而没有混杂被否证（carries_unregistered、Confound.refutes_registered）。不加前提。
claim.en: Determinacy is determinacy up to likeness where the claims name the configurations (determined_iff_named, alike_configurations), so each theorem stated with Determined is the named instance of one stated with DeterminedAt. These hold up to likeness: going alike through likeness is determinacy up to likeness (goesAlike_iff, after goAlike_id_iff); runs alike stay alike (DeterminedAt.stays_alike, after GoAlike.runs_agree); what the step does not depend on is re-absorbed up to likeness (DependsOnlyOnAlike.reabsorbed); with the noise forgotten, the standard model is determined up to likeness exactly where the noise makes no difference up to likeness (forget_inputs_determinedAt_iff); a move taken is fixed up to likeness (Run.fixesAlike_of_takes) and one occasion stands for its class (Run.generalizesAlike); a move taken at no configuration alike to the one named is not fixed, for outcomes that differ in a claim (Run.not_fixesAlike_of_untaken), through an intervention on a whole likeness class (retargetAlike, retargetAlike_determinedAt). These need equality, or claims registering what equality tells apart: retargeting one of two alike configurations breaks determinacy up to likeness (Twins.retarget_breaks); a kept history returns up to likeness where its present does and nothing registers the past (keepFrame_alike_iff, keepHistory_returns_alike), so keepHistory_new needs the past registered (keepHistory_new_named); with nothing claimed, every description carries a law and no confound is refuted (carries_unregistered, Confound.refutes_registered). No premise.

hypotheses.zh: carries_law_iff 在相似之下没有双向形式，只给出平凡性见证；not_fixesThrough_* 没有重述。
hypotheses.en: carries_law_iff has no two-way form up to likeness, only the triviality witness; not_fixesThrough_* are not restated.

correspondence.zh: P81（工作板），同上；回应 configurations-alike-by-relation 的 next_delta。读法（AI 的，待 Ren）：相似是展开自身的构型同一；在相似之下成立的确定定理关乎构型如何相关，需要相等的那些依赖于所登记的：对相似者中一个名字的干预、没有登记的过去、没有登记的描述。没有登记的既不被固定也不被否证（比较 Becoming.Testing 的登记）。见整合文档 §{S}。
correspondence.en: P81 (work board), as above; answering the next_delta of configurations-alike-by-relation. Reading (the AI's, pending Ren): likeness is the unfolding's own identity of configurations; the theorems with determinacy that hold up to likeness are about how configurations relate, and those that need equality depend on what is registered: an intervention on one name among alike configurations, a past nothing registers, a description nothing registers. What nothing registers is neither fixed nor refuted (compare the registers of Becoming.Testing). See the integration document §{S}.
